sections.title: Zero-to-deaths
sections.blurb: From 0% to a KO with the game's own combo counter never resetting. Each one is frame-perfect and true only against the DI it was found with; the list under each clip says what holds and what doesn't.

sections.title: Kill confirms
sections.blurb: Short confirms from a coal hit into a kill, at the percent shown.

sections.title: Coal, rope and ant
sections.blurb: How the coal, the rope and the ant really behave, measured in the engine.

sections.title: Ledgetraps
sections.blurb: Coal tossed to the ledge, then the ant called on reaction. The opponent is scripted to pick each getup 25 frames after grabbing the ledge.

sections.title: Edgeguards
sections.blurb: Against the game's level-9 CPU, which takes over as soon as Chomp's hit lands.

clips.title: Coal relay across the stage
facts: Relay window: 3 frames either side of the mark; 1 frame off or less adds speed
Plain toss lands 33 units away (7.6%); 3 perfect relays: 101 units (8.8%); high toss + 3 perfect relays: 119 units (10.5%)
Relays 2 frames off still relay but add nothing (7.6%)

clips.title: Ant anti-air with a full hop
facts: Chomp full hops 20 frames after calling the ant: the rope swings up and the ant meets the jumping foe (8.8%)
Hopping at 26, 32 or 38 frames missed
The rope keeps the ant's progress, so moving Chomp swings the ant around the coal

clips.title: The same call without the hop
facts: The ant runs under the jumping foe: no hit

clips.title: The rope is a ramp, not a hitbox
facts: The rope never deals damage
A foe falling onto a sloped rope is slowed from 1.55 to about 0.3 per frame and slides down it toward the coal
A flat rope on the floor never blocks walking; jumping lifts the rope over a standing foe

clips.title: The ant beats a grab
facts: Grabs never cut the rope: a grab started on the rope line is interrupted by the ant
Same result against Flint and Knell

clips.title: A damaging attack cuts the rope
facts: Any active damaging hitbox near the rope cuts it
Potato Sack's jab, ftilt and dtilt cut it when started 4–20 frames after the call; Flint's dtilt 4–24
Flint's jab and ftilt lose to the ant; Knell loses to it with everything tested

clips.title: Neutral getup: caught
facts: Coal tossed to the ledge (lands at x 60), Chomp waits at x 20, 48 units away
Ant called 12 frames after the foe leaves the ledge
Caught every time against Flint, Sack and Knell

clips.title: Ledge roll: caught
facts: Caught every time

clips.title: Ledge jump: caught
facts: Caught every time; drop then double jump was caught too

clips.title: Getup attack gets through
facts: Gets through 3 times out of 4 (Flint, Sack); Knell's is caught
Standing at the ledge (x 46) with only fsmash covers the same options; the ant's gain is doing it from 48 units away

clips.title: Ledge fsmash kills at 100%
facts: Kills 4/4 at 100% against Flint and Potato Sack, and at 80% against Knell, with the level-9 CPU recovering
Hanging the coal off-stage with the ant hits the recovering CPU often (6–15%) but never stopped it recovering
Off-stage rope bite, fair and cushion only add kills against Knell (40–60%)

clips.title: Four Rope Swings and the bite
facts: 133 units with the stick untouched; 218 holding forward, enough to carry him off the far side
Rope Swing, wait 20, hop: 76 units; 4 swings and a hop: 122

clips.title: Wall-swing pop
facts: Swinging while pinned against the island's side wall keeps the swing running
Once he rises past the floor he snaps to where the swing would be: up to 49.9 units in one frame, onto the stage
256 of 360 tested routes from below the ledge did it
Not fixed

intro: Chomp Chomp tested in the real Emberfall engine: 51 search jobs, 6.49 million route branches and 274 million simulated frames, then every result replayed under DI, SDI, escape attempts, the level-9 CPU and late inputs. Every clip here was recorded from the game itself.
note: No game code, balance or mechanic was changed, and no glitch was fixed. Each zero-to-death is true only against the DI shown on its card; the level-9 CPU escapes all of them. The brief arrived cut off at "Explore thousands", read here as exploring thousands of routes.
footer: Testing tools: tools/chomp-lab.js, chomp-node.js, chomp-search.js, chomp-verify.js, chomp-record.js and chomp-album.js. The full report, with every table and what remains unverified, is README.md in this folder. 2026-11-12.
